**VERDICT: pass — both route classes found and reproducible, but degenerate; two objective defects found first.** CPU 1.19 s, one bounded run.

## Answer to the commission
Same-endpoint outer (reference-clear, no witness) and shorter (occluded, one witness) routes **exist** on the present Origin tree/shore geometry and both fit the caps. The distinction is real but **2–8 samples wide** and rests entirely on the hero trunk, because the arena has **no terrain relief**.

## Defects (unambiguous, cause named)
1. **`planAgentSurfaceRoute` is blind to the hero trunk collider.** It knows terrain voxels only; the unrestricted shortest tree→shore route occupies cell `[-12,11]`, pose `(-24.00,51.05,22.00)` — inside the trunk box. Must be fixed before any W-7744 route near the tree is authored.
2. **Pass-1's ray was not shipped truth.** `shouldVoxelExist` is not clipped to the rendered cube; `agentSurfaceNavigation` gates it with `insideRenderedTerrain (≤25)`, pass 1 did not. 717 columns report solid at y=26; on 48 comparison lines pass-1 blocks 48/48, the gated DDA blocks 0/48. **Pass-1's 29.3 % terrain-occlusion census is an artifact.** Pass-1's eye 1.6 was unsourced (real: visor 1.85, chest 1.30, hand 1.25, `PLAYER_EYE_HEIGHT` 1.35); its 3.0-unit near-field exemption is unnecessary (0 self-column hits with correct DDA).

## Measurements (shared endpoints `(-28.00,51.05,22.00)` → `(4.00,51.05,-10.00)`)
Fixed reference `(-30.00,51.05,32.00)`, support `[-15,25,16]`, socket 1.85 → `(-30.00,52.90,32.00)`.

| | Outer (no witness) | Shorter (needs witness) | Cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Length | **68.00** | **64.00** | 120 (headroom 52) |
| Samples | **96** | **92** | 128 (headroom 32) |
| Blocked samples | **0** | **2** (both trunk, 0 terrain) | — |
| Occluded span | — | `(-23,51.05,20)`→`(-22,51.05,20)` | — |

Binding bound = **points**; neither cap approached, so this run neither confirms nor refutes the pass-1 "120 units vs 128 samples" concern. Caps not relaxed, no corner decimated.

Planner cross-validation: outer 34/34 edges + 10/10 corner legs, shorter 32/32 + 10/10, rejected-cell sample 26/26 agree. All `walk` / `dry-surface-path`, no water/jetpack/cross-face.

## Why it's degenerate
- **Support-height histogram = `{"25": 1193}`** — every walkable node is on the flat cube-face plateau. No relief can occlude a level sightline.
- Across all 96 candidate references (30 qualifying): outer always 68.00, shorter always 64.00, detour always **+4.00 units**; occluded samples 2–8, **trunk in every case, terrain zero**. Widest shadow: reference `(-22.00,51.05,26.00)` → 8/92 samples.
- **981/1193 nodes (82 %)** discharge the witness requirement, including the start reference itself (walk distance 0). Stable across reference sockets 0.6/1.0/1.35/1.85.

## Director packet (geometry, not proposals)
(a) sign as-is; (b) reference at `(-22,51.05,26)` for the widest shadow this geometry offers; (c) re-pick endpoints so the pond — the only non-flat feature — lies between them (not measured; new endpoint pair is a director call); (d) reopen the bounded arena decision per CG-CIN-CH-02. Defect 1 must be fixed regardless.

## Limitations
Pristine procedural terrain only (no live edits; live confirmation still needs a client + contracted debug hook). Nothing visually verified — no render/GPU/night/mobile/reduced-motion/tier/readability. Reference sweep is 96 candidates at 3–24 units, bounded not exhaustive. Witness cylinders/hysteresis not simulated, only the world-space line. Sockets are **measured candidates**, not canon.
